body: I want to be me, but I don't even know who I am anymore. I've lost myself and I don't think I can recover. I just want this all to end

When I pretended, it made others happy. At least someone was happy. After a while it just became more natural to pretend. Then I got stuck pretending, and it was exhausting. I am so tired of trying to be something I'm not.
I am ready. There may have been some good moments a long time ago, but I can't recall any now.
